description: A MAUI Windows build fails with CsWinRT analyzer errors requiring partial classes, based on https://github.com/dotnet/maui/issues/25132.
prompt: My Windows build started failing after moving the MAUI app to the newer SDK. The error points at one of our Windows-only controls: `CsWinRT1028: Class 'MauiCommandBar' implements WinRT interfaces but isn't marked partial. Type should be marked partial for trimming and AOT compatibility if passed across the WinRT ABI.` I don't want to turn off all analyzers if this is a real project issue.
